g.text: d The six events with measured ML > 4
Fitting across the magnitude range: restore the bin-median method
Each curve uses all accepted training magnitudes, with the stated weights. Open squares: the same filtered bin medians used for the bin fits.
The previous headline and bin-OLS coefficients reproduce exactly. Bin-median ODR is an additional equal-axis check. NW4/NW2 magnitudes remain separate.
